tasks.title: Implement bounded operator-bound original command receipts
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Deliver the typed browser session-storage receipt primitive used by portal commands: create original key before submit, retain only operator association/family/exact target/key/time, at most16 receipts with24-hour UI retention, no credentials/claims/payload/draft persistence. Expiry removes only UI references and never backend duplicate protection. Recovery stays with original key/family/target and fresh permission, one selected recovery request at a time; timeout/NotFound/lookup denial cannot authorize automatic replacement work. No server draft database or generic workflow ledger. Owns receipt portions of RM09-AC09, RM09-AC10, RM09-AC12, RM09-AC17, RM09-AC19 and RM10-AC28.
tasks.validation: Test bounded strict parsing, count/byte/age/family/target, same-user reload and original-key retention through uncertain outcome/lookup refusal with existing portal unit tools. Document UI receipt versus RM03 protection and independently review the implementation. This initial unstarted split still has generated inherited dependencies; the controller must refine its concrete prerequisite/ownership validation through the supported child update before activating implementation.

tasks.title: Implement protected in-memory drafts and late-response session isolation
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Deliver shared protected in-memory draft/request state used by upcoming metadata/Configuration/task flows. Session expiry/signout/user switch clears affected protected content/drafts/receipts and blocks writes/recovery; permission loss clears protected values and leaves only same-user minimal receipts when appropriate. Track exact user/application/environment/definition/schema request context so cancellation or a late old response cannot refill a different user's or environment's screen. Retain only dated allowed snapshots on transient outage, disable submissions and queue nothing until fresh state. Drafts are memory-only with unsaved navigation protection; no payload persistence. Owns state-lifetime slices of RM09-AC09, RM09-AC10, RM09-AC12, RM09-AC14, RM09-AC17, RM09-AC19 and RM10-AC28, RM10-AC29.
tasks.validation: Use existing controlled delayed-request/session tests for switch/signout/expiry/grant loss, same-user receipt restoration, definition changes and exact protected state clearing. Include keyboard/navigation protection where this primitive affects it, documentation and independent review; actual full UI journeys remain with their component owners. This initial unstarted split still has generated inherited dependencies; the controller must refine its concrete prerequisite/ownership validation through the supported child update before activating implementation.
